content:
maya: @support-liaison heads-up — multiple 401s from AcmeCorp services starting 03:20 UTC, token signature errors.
jess: saw that, digging. logs show:
```
ERROR auth: token verification failed: no matching JWK for kid "abc123"
WARN auth: fallback jwks-fetch returned 200 but keyset missing kid
``` 
samir: are they on rotating keys? last rotation was 03:15 UTC per their support notes.
maya: yes, they rotate every 5 mins for HA.
support-liaison: customer says they didn't change anything on their side, tokens minted by our OIDC provider failing.
sre-oncall: rolling back jwks-cache TTL to 30s? current cache TTL 10m from env var JWKS_CACHE_TTL.
jess: that helps but we also have race where cache return happens before fetch completed -> code ignores missing kid. stack:
```
// simplified
if (cache.has(jwks_url)) return cache.get(jwks_url);
const resp = await fetch(jwks_url);
cache.set(jwks_url, resp.keys, ttl);
```
If cached value was partial (empty) we end up with no matching kid.
maya: repro steps I used:
1) set JWKS_CACHE_TTL=600
2) trigger key rotation at issuer
3) spin up 10 concurrent token-verifiers that fetch jwks on miss
4) observe intermittent 'no matching JWK' and signature errors
jess: quick mitigation: treat empty cache entries as miss and trigger background refresh + add 60s leeway to exp check.
samir: dug into issuer logs — rotation endpoint sometimes returns 202 while key material still propagating to CDN (edge delay ~20s).
ops-bot: deploy job started: rollout/jwks-cache-fix v1.2 -> canary on api-pool-3
support-liaison: I've told AcmeCorp to retry for 1-2 mins; they're seeing partial recovery.
sre-oncall: followups: (1) change cache strategy to 'optimistic merge' and mark failed partial fetches as retryable; (2) add 30s clock-leeway for signature verification; (3) monitor 'kid-miss' metric and alert at 5/min.
jess: I'll open a postmortem template and link logs. assigning to @samir for code change and @maya for runbook updates.
maya: adding runbook steps and customer-facing playbook snippet:
```
If customer reports signature errors:
- confirm token issuer and kid
- curl <jwks_url> and check keys
- if missing: trigger jwks-refresh && ask issuer for propagation window
- escalate to eng-security if >5m
```
support-liaison: acme ok for now, will update if it reappears :thumbsup:
